name: Mothers And Sons
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of mothers in the spiritual instruction and upbringing of their sons, emphasizing the importance of honoring and obeying parents as a foundation for a blessed life. The Proverbs passages show that a wise son brings joy to his mother and father, while folly causes sorrow, underscoring the impact of a son's character on his family. Ephesians calls children to obey their parents in the Lord, affirming this obedience as right and pleasing to God. Together, these verses affirm the God-ordained relationship between mothers and sons, centered on teaching, respect, and godly living.
